name: Abubakar Salim
biography: Abubakar Salim is a British actor, producer and video-game voice actor. He has provided his voice and motion capture for video games such as Ubisoft's Assassin's Creed: Origins (2017) and has acted in television series such as Informer (2018), Jamestown (2018) and Raised by Wolves (2020).
movies: Thomas & Friends: Big World! Big Adventures! The Movie
birthplace: Welwyn Garden City, Hertfordshire, England, UK
